product: BrainDrift: brain fluid-shift gate (Model B live brain map, Model A precomputed PVS map, simulated flight)
live: models/braindrift_anat.onnx (Model B) runs in the browser; everything else is precomputed
ids: flight-f000..f100 = 5 frames of one held-out OASIS test brain (flight-brain); brain-small / brain-large = smallest / largest ventricles of the 40-brain test set; pvs-low / pvs-mid / pvs-high = 3 held-out HCP-Aging test people (neutral ids; no subject ids, ages or sexes shipped)
licence_data: OASIS-1 (Marcus et al. 2007) via neurite-oasis (Hoopes et al. 2021): OASIS Data Use Terms (cite; no re-identification; skull-stripped crops only). OpenNeuro ds005595 (Chai et al.): CC0, NIA U01AG052564 acknowledgement. Repeat-scan numbers: OpenNeuro ds000239 (Maclaren et al. 2014), CC0.
privacy: no faces (skull-stripped / brain-masked, axial slices above the eyes), no raw HCP T2, no OASIS orig, no ages or sexes, no subject ids, no QA overlay PNGs
